title: Momentum: Persistent Dynamics for Video World Models
title_zh: Momentum：面向视频世界模型的持久动态机制

paragraphs.en: Video world models must capture how a scene evolves beyond the current camera view to generate consistent observations when its content reappears. Existing approaches rely on observation history, static point clouds, or image caches constructed from past frames. These representations are often expensive and, more importantly, cannot update dynamic scene content outside the field of view: generated vehicles and pedestrians may be forgotten after leaving the field of view or reappear in physically inaccurate states. We represent an evolving scene through synchronized videos from reference-camera rigs, each comprising eight cameras that jointly cover the surrounding scene. We connect these rigs in a graph and propagate video generation between neighboring rigs to coordinate scene dynamics across locations and time. We introduce Momentum, a two-stage pipeline: WorldUpdate jointly generates reference-camera videos as a shared memory of scene dynamics, and WorldInteract grounds camera-controlled video generation in this evolving memory, allowing moving content to remain represented outside the target view and reappear consistently. To support training and evaluation, we develop a CARLA pipeline that captures synchronized videos from reference camera rigs and a moving target camera, together with an evaluation framework measuring consistency within the generated world state and the target observations. Experiments on generated street scenes show that grounding target videos in scene dynamics generated by Momentum improves dynamic scene consistency by 126.2 % 126.2\% in unseen scenes over static image conditioning, while also improving visual fidelity. Our models and source code will be made publicly available.

paragraphs.en: Video world models simulate how visual environments evolve over time and respond to actions, supporting applications in game generation ( Team et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2025b ; Qian et al., 2026 ) , robotic learning and control ( Gao et al., 2026a ; Ye et al., 2026 ) , autonomous driving simulation ( Wayve, 2026 ; Basant et al., 2026 ) , and virtual-world exploration ( Ball et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2025 ) . In these settings, the generated video reveals only a partial view of an environment whose contents and dynamics extend beyond what is currently visible. As the viewpoint changes, the generated observations should remain consistent with both the scene’s spatial structure and the motion of objects within it. A vehicle approaching an intersection should follow the same course whether the generated video follows it, shows it from another viewpoint, or turns away and later shows it again. This requires grounding generation to a world representation that evolves through time.
paragraphs.zh: 视频世界模型模拟视觉环境如何随时间演化并对动作做出响应，支持游戏生成（Team et al., 2026; Yu et al., 2025b; Qian et al., 2026）、机器人学习与控制（Gao et al., 2026a; Ye et al., 2026）、自动驾驶仿真（Wayve, 2026; Basant et al., 2026）以及虚拟世界探索（Ball et al., 2025; Team et al., 2026; Sun et al., 2025）等应用。 在这些场景中，生成的视频只揭示环境的部分视图，而环境的内容与动态延伸到了当前可见范围之外。 随着视角变化，生成的观测应当与场景的空间结构以及其中物体的运动保持一致。 一辆驶近路口的车辆，无论生成的视频是跟随它、从另一个视角拍摄它，还是转向别处之后再重新拍到它，都应沿着相同的路线行驶。 这就要求将生成过程锚定在一个随时间演化的世界表示之上。

paragraphs.en: Existing memory mechanisms provide part of this grounding through observation history or persistent spatial representations. Conditioning on past frames preserves local continuity, but a finite context limits how much of the environment remains accessible ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Savov et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026 ) . Image caches ( Xiao et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Yu et al., 2025a ) , depth maps ( Ren et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2026 ) , and reconstructed point clouds ( Ren et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025c ) extend spatial memory by retaining information from previously observed locations. However, stored observations describe the scene at the time they were captured. Without a mechanism for advancing their contents, they cannot provide temporally updated grounding for a moving camera. The challenge is therefore to maintain a representation that specifies both what exists at a location and how its state changes over time.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的记忆机制通过观测历史或持久的空间表征提供了这种定位依据的一部分。 以过去的帧为条件可以保持局部连续性，但有限的上下文限制了环境中仍可访问的部分 ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Savov et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026 ) 。 图像缓存 ( Xiao et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Yu et al., 2025a ) 、深度图 ( Ren et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2026 ) 和重建的点云 ( Ren et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025c ) 通过保留先前观测到的位置的信息来扩展空间记忆。 然而，存储的观测描述的是它们被捕获时的场景。 缺乏推进其内容的机制，它们就无法为移动的相机提供时间上更新的定位依据。 因此，挑战在于维护一种同时指明某位置存在什么以及其状态如何随时间变化的表征。

paragraphs.en: Recent approaches have begun to model dynamics beyond the current camera view through explicit object-level motion plans or entity-centered simulation within a static background ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Duan et al., 2026 ) . These advances support persistent dynamics for selected entities, while maintaining the evolution of general scene content remains relatively unexplored. We pursue a representation that evolves scene content across a coordinated network of reference cameras, without requiring explicit object trajectories, identity tracking, or a static-dynamic scene decomposition.

paragraphs.en: Seoul World Model (SWM) offers a useful foundation through image-based spatial grounding ( Seo et al., 2026 ) . It conditions camera-controlled video generation on retrieved street-view images, using geometric reprojection and semantic referencing to anchor generated observations to a particular environment. These references ground the scene’s spatial structure and appearance, while motion is synthesized within the generated video. We extend this principle to spatiotemporal grounding : synchronized videos from spatially distributed reference cameras provide a shared account of both scene appearance and motion. The target camera is thus grounded in the scene at the corresponding location and time, allowing different camera trajectories to observe the same unfolding dynamics.
paragraphs.zh: 首尔世界模型（SWM）通过基于图像的空间定位提供了一个有用的基础（Seo et al., 2026）。 该模型以检索到的街景图像为条件进行相机可控视频生成，利用几何重投影和语义参照将生成的观测锚定到特定环境中。 这些参照为场景的空间结构和外观提供定位，而运动则在生成的视频内进行合成。 我们将这一原则扩展到时空定位：来自空间分布的参考相机的同步视频，为场景外观和运动提供了共同的记录。 因此，目标相机在对应位置和时间上被锚定于场景之中，使不同的相机轨迹能够观察同一展开的动态过程。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Momentum, a two-stage pipeline in which WorldUpdate generates an evolving world state and WorldInteract uses it to ground camera-controlled video generation. The method is presented on Fig. 1 . The state is organized as a graph of panoramic rigs, each comprising eight reference cameras. WorldUpdate jointly generates videos for the eight cameras of each rig and propagates generation through the graph, conditioning each rig on geometrically reprojected video from an already generated neighbor. This couples the evolution of scene content across reference viewpoints. WorldInteract then generates video along a target camera trajectory using the resulting world rollout as spatiotemporal grounding. The reference videos therefore serve both as the simulation of scene dynamics and as their persistent representation, enabling motion outside the target camera’s view to remain part of the state used to generate subsequent observations.

paragraphs.en: To develop this pipeline, we build an SWM-based image-grounded model on Cosmos Predict 2.5 and a CARLA data-generation framework that provides training and evaluation data for both stages. The framework captures static reference images and synchronized videos from fixed reference-camera rigs to supervise world-state generation. It also records videos along diverse moving target-camera trajectories, providing supervision for camera-controlled generation grounded in the reference observations. These observations provide supervision for generating a dynamic world state and for rendering camera-controlled video consistent with that state. We develop an evaluation framework for dynamic grounding, combining visual, camera-control, and scene-consistency metrics to assess the evolving world representation and the consistency of target videos with its dynamics. We evaluate our SWM-based baseline on real-world driving data and assess dynamic grounding on CARLA scenes from seen and unseen towns. Generating reference videos introduces an additional inference stage, trading computation for a shared representation of scene dynamics beyond the current view. This cost can be amortized across multiple target-camera trajectories grounded in the same world rollout, while improving dynamic consistency over static image grounding. With ground-truth reference videos, the Dynamically Grounded WM improves visual fidelity, camera control, and scene consistency over static grounding across single- and multi-rig settings. End-to-end, Momentum generates its own reference videos and improves dynamic scene consistency by 130.2 % 130.2\% in seen towns and 126.2 % 126.2\% in an unseen town compared with the Dynamically Grounded WM conditioned on static images.
paragraphs.zh: 为开发这一流程，我们在 Cosmos Predict 2.5 上构建了基于 SWM 的图像接地模型，并构建了 CARLA 数据生成框架，为两个阶段提供训练和评估数据。 该框架从固定的参考相机机位采集静态参考图像和同步视频，用于监督世界状态生成。 它还沿多样的移动目标相机轨迹录制视频，为基于参考观测的相机控制生成提供监督。 这些观测为生成动态世界状态以及渲染与该状态一致的相机控制视频提供监督。 我们开发了一套动态接地评估框架，结合视觉、相机控制和场景一致性指标，来评估不断演进的世界表征以及目标视频与其动态的一致性。 我们在真实世界驾驶数据上评估基于 SWM 的基线，并在已见和未见城镇的 CARLA 场景上评估动态接地能力。 生成参考视频引入了额外的推理阶段，以计算开销换取超越当前视野的场景动态共享表征。 这一开销可以在基于同一世界推演的多个目标相机轨迹间摊销，同时相比静态图像接地提升了动态一致性。 使用真值参考视频时，动态接地世界模型在单机位和多机位设置下，均比静态接地提升了视觉保真度、相机控制和场景一致性。 端到端而言，Momentum 自行生成参考视频，与以静态图像为条件的动态接地世界模型相比，在已见城镇中将动态场景一致性提升了 130.2 % 130.2\%，在未见城镇中提升了 126.2 % 126.2\%。

sents.en: The framework captures static reference images and synchronized videos from fixed reference-camera rigs to supervise world-state generation.
sents.zh: 该框架从固定的参考相机机位采集静态参考图像和同步视频，用于监督世界状态生成。

sents.en: It also records videos along diverse moving target-camera trajectories, providing supervision for camera-controlled generation grounded in the reference observations.
sents.zh: 它还沿多样的移动目标相机轨迹录制视频，为基于参考观测的相机控制生成提供监督。

sents.en: These observations provide supervision for generating a dynamic world state and for rendering camera-controlled video consistent with that state.
sents.zh: 这些观测为生成动态世界状态以及渲染与该状态一致的相机控制视频提供监督。

sents.en: We develop an evaluation framework for dynamic grounding, combining visual, camera-control, and scene-consistency metrics to assess the evolving world representation and the consistency of target videos with its dynamics.
sents.zh: 我们开发了一套动态接地评估框架，结合视觉、相机控制和场景一致性指标，来评估不断演进的世界表征以及目标视频与其动态的一致性。

sents.en: We evaluate our SWM-based baseline on real-world driving data and assess dynamic grounding on CARLA scenes from seen and unseen towns.

sents.en: Generating reference videos introduces an additional inference stage, trading computation for a shared representation of scene dynamics beyond the current view.

sents.en: This cost can be amortized across multiple target-camera trajectories grounded in the same world rollout, while improving dynamic consistency over static image grounding.

paragraphs.en: We introduce a spatiotemporal world representation comprising a graph of reference-camera rigs with synchronized multi-view videos, providing shared spatial and dynamic grounding across camera viewpoints and time.
paragraphs.zh: 我们引入了一种时空世界表示，它由一个参考相机机组图组成，这些相机机组配备同步的多视角视频，为跨相机视点和跨时间提供共享的空间与动态基础。

paragraphs.en: We propose Momentum, a two-stage pipeline that generates scene dynamics through graph-propagated multi-view generation in WorldUpdate and grounds camera-controlled observations in those dynamics through WorldInteract.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Momentum，这是一个两阶段流水线，通过 WorldUpdate 中的图传播多视角生成来生成场景动态，并通过 WorldInteract 将相机控制的观测建立在这些动态之上。

paragraphs.en: We develop a CARLA data-generation pipeline for synchronized reference and target camera observations, an evaluation framework for assessing dynamic scene consistency in both the generated world representation and the resulting target videos, and an image-grounded world model based on SWM.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一个用于同步参考相机与目标相机观测的 CARLA 数据生成流水线、一个用于评估生成世界表征及由此产生的目标视频中动态场景一致性的评估框架，以及一个基于 SWM 的图像驱动世界模型。

paragraphs.en: Building on learned models of environment dynamics ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ) , generative video world models increasingly support interactive visual environments across domains. Genie ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; Ball et al., 2025 ) , LingBot-World ( Team et al., 2026 ) , and HY-WorldPlay ( Sun et al., 2025 ) enable controllable exploration. DIAMOND ( Alonso et al., 2024 ) , GameFactory ( Yu et al., 2025b ) , and Matrix-Game 3.5 ( Qian et al., 2026 ) develop interactive game-like simulation, while Pandora ( Xiang et al., 2024 ) uses natural-language actions to guide video evolution. Driving models such as GAIA ( Wayve, 2026 ) and OmniDreams ( Basant et al., 2026 ) generate controllable observations for simulation and evaluation. In robotics, DreamDojo ( Gao et al., 2026a ) learns action-conditioned simulation from human-video priors, DreamZero ( Ye et al., 2026 ) jointly predicts future video and robot actions for control, and RoboWorld ( Jeon et al., 2026 ) supports robot-policy evaluation through video simulation. Cosmos ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ; Agarwal et al., 2026 ) provides pretrained world-model capabilities for physical AI; we build on Cosmos Predict 2.5 ( Ali et al., 2025 ) . Our focus is on organizing generated dynamics into a persistent world state that grounds observations across target-camera trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 基于习得的环境动态模型（Ha 和 Schmidhuber，2018），生成式视频世界模型日益广泛地支持跨领域的交互式视觉环境。 Genie（Bruce 等，2024；Ball 等，2025）、LingBot-World（Team 等，2026）和 HY-WorldPlay（Sun 等，2025）实现了可控的探索。 DIAMOND（Alonso 等，2024）、GameFactory（Yu 等，2025b）和 Matrix-Game 3.5（Qian 等，2026）开发了交互式的类游戏模拟，而 Pandora（Xiang 等，2024）则利用自然语言动作来引导视频演化。 GAIA（Wayve，2026）和 OmniDreams（Basant 等，2026）等驾驶模型生成可控的观测，用于模拟与评估。 在机器人领域，DreamDojo（Gao 等，2026a）从人类视频先验中学习动作条件化的模拟，DreamZero（Ye 等，2026）联合预测未来视频与机器人动作以实现控制，RoboWorld（Jeon 等，2026）则通过视频模拟支持机器人策略评估。 Cosmos（Agarwal 等，2025；Agarwal 等，2026）为物理人工智能提供了预训练的世界模型能力；我们构建于 Cosmos Predict 2.5（Ali 等，2025）之上。 我们的重点在于将生成的动态组织成持久的世界状态，从而为跨目标相机轨迹的观测提供基础。

paragraphs.en: Memory mechanisms extend generation beyond a short observation window. StateSpaceDiffuser ( Savov et al., 2026 ) uses recurrent state-space modeling, FramePack ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) compresses frame history, and Mixture of Contexts ( Cai et al., 2026 ) learns sparse attention over informative temporal contexts. WorldMem ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) , VRAG ( Chen et al., 2026b ) , Context-as-Memory ( Yu et al., 2025a ) , and MemCam ( Gao et al., 2026b ) retrieve historical observations. Spatial organization further supports consistency through 3D caches in GEN3C ( Ren et al., 2025 ) , surfel indexing in VMem ( Li et al., 2025c ) , and geometric memory in SPMem ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , Captain Safari ( Chou et al., 2026 ) , and Lyra 2.0 ( Shen et al., 2026 ) . Latent Spatial Memory ( Wang et al., 2026b ) stores spatial information in diffusion latent space, while SWM ( Seo et al., 2026 ) grounds generation in external street-view images. These mechanisms retain past evidence, but memory retention alone does not advance the represented scene through time.

paragraphs.en: Dynamic geometric methods such as NVFi ( Li et al., 2023 ) , FreeGave ( Li et al., 2025b ) , and TRACE ( Li et al., 2025a ) predict future RGB views by fitting scene dynamics to recorded videos. We instead reuse a dynamics model across scenes and spatial regions without scene-specific fitting. InfiniCube ( Lu et al., 2025 ) and WorldSplat ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) generate dynamic environments under supplied object-motion controls; our model generates scene evolution without prescribed object trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: NVFi ( Li et al., 2023 )、FreeGave ( Li et al., 2025b ) 和 TRACE ( Li et al., 2025a ) 等动态几何方法通过将场景动力学拟合到录制视频来预测未来的 RGB 视图。 我们则跨场景和空间区域复用一个动力学模型，而无需针对场景进行拟合。 InfiniCube ( Lu et al., 2025 ) 和 WorldSplat ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) 在给定物体运动控制的条件下生成动态环境；而我们的模型在没有指定物体轨迹的情况下生成场景演化。

paragraphs.en: Persistent dynamics beyond the target view remain relatively unexplored. HyDRA ( Chen et al., 2026a ) retrieves motion and appearance cues for hidden subjects, while MosaicMem ( Yu et al., 2026 ) and Mem-World ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) combine spatial memory with dynamic video generation. WorldDirector ( Wang et al., 2026a ) plans object trajectories through an LLM, and LiveWorld ( Duan et al., 2026 ) advances active entities through virtual monitors against a static background. Momentum instead organizes its evolving state by spatial regions: coordinated reference-camera videos generate and represent scene dynamics, then ground target-camera observations. This formulation supports spatial extension through additional rigs without explicit entity tracking or a static–dynamic decomposition.
paragraphs.zh: 超越目标视角的持续性动态仍相对缺乏研究。 HyDRA（Chen et al., 2026a）为被遮挡主体检索运动与外观线索，而 MosaicMem（Yu et al., 2026）和 Mem-World（Zheng et al., 2026）则将空间记忆与动态视频生成相结合。 WorldDirector（Wang et al., 2026a）通过大语言模型规划物体轨迹，LiveWorld（Duan et al., 2026）则借助虚拟屏幕在静态背景之上推进主动实体。 相反，Momentum 按空间区域来组织其不断演化的状态：由多个参考相机协同生成的视频生成并表达场景动态，进而为目标相机的观测提供依据。 这一形式化方式无需显式的实体跟踪或静态–动态分解，即可通过增加额外的相机机位实现空间扩展。

paragraphs.en: Training and evaluating our models requires reference observations paired with target-camera trajectories, with synchronized video for dynamic grounding. paragraphs.en: We pair target videos with panoramic reference rigs covering the same maps. Each rig contains eight outward-facing cameras spaced 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} apart in yaw, positioned 2 2 m above the road. Rigs follow the road graph at 20 20 m intervals with small random positional offsets. Captures are separated by 2.4 2.4 s, equivalent to 30 30 km/h travel, allowing dynamic content to evolve between neighboring captures as in street-view acquisition. Target videos span 36 36 s at 10 10 fps along vehicle (autopilot), pedestrian (AI-controlled walker), or flyover (freely moving elevated camera) trajectories. References and targets are captured in independent sessions with independently sampled conditions, sharing static structure while differing in transient content.

paragraphs.en: To supervise evolving reference views, we capture reference and target videos in a shared simulation rollout. A moving target camera traverses a randomly selected intersection covered by one panoramic rig ( single-rig ) or up to four spatially distributed rigs ( multi-rig ). Each session spans 300 300 frames at 10 10 fps, with synchronized observations depicting the same scene evolution. To reduce storage, rigs record new observations only when the target camera is within 25 25 m; otherwise, their latest frames are repeated to retain temporal alignment. Active intervals provide eight synchronized streams per rig for world-state supervision, while target trajectories revisit shared content from different viewpoints and headings to supervise grounded camera-controlled generation.

paragraphs.en: The backbone is a Diffusion Transformer operating in the latent space of a causal 3D VAE, initialized from Cosmos Predict 2.5-2B ( Ali et al., 2025 ) . Per-frame Plücker ray maps, encoded by a shallow convolutional encoder and added to latent tokens, provide camera poses for history, target, reference, and sink latents. We train under teacher forcing on the CARLA data of Sec. 3.2 .

paragraphs.en: Each chunk retrieves up to K K reference images near the target trajectory, with camera poses and metric depth supplied by CARLA during training and estimated with Depth Anything V3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) at inference. Two pathways incorporate these references. Geometric referencing unprojects the nearest references for each target frame into a point cloud and forward-splats it into the target viewpoint; the resulting warped video is encoded and concatenated channel-wise with noisy target latents for dense spatial conditioning. Semantic referencing encodes each reference into a single latent, appended to the token sequence at a RoPE temporal position separated from the generation window by G ref G_{\mathrm{ref}} . Target latents attend to all K K references to recover appearance information lost through depth errors or occlusion.
paragraphs.zh: 每个分块会检索最多 K K 张靠近目标轨迹的参考图像，其相机位姿与度量深度在训练时由 CARLA 提供，在推理时用 Depth Anything V3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) 进行估计。 两条通路会利用这些参考。 几何参照将每个目标帧最近的参考反投影为点云，并前向泼溅到目标视角；得到的形变视频经编码后与带噪目标潜变量在通道维度上拼接，以提供稠密的空间条件。 语义参照将每条参考编码为单个潜变量，并附加到 token 序列中一个与生成窗口相隔 G ref G_{\mathrm{ref}} 的 RoPE 时间位置上。 目标潜变量会关注全部 K K 条参考，以恢复因深度误差或遮挡而丢失的外观信息。

paragraphs.en: Momentum is a two-stage pipeline that generates an evolving world state and uses it to ground camera-controlled video. The architecture of our method is shown on Fig. 2 . The state S t S_{t} comprises the reference-camera rig views, advanced through time rather than held fixed. WorldUpdate implements the state transition S H : H + T = g ( S H ) S_{H:H+T}=g(S_{H}) , generating synchronized videos across rigs to represent scene dynamics independently of the target-camera trajectory. WorldInteract implements the observation model h h , generating target-camera video conditioned on the observation history, camera trajectory, and corresponding world state. The reference videos thus serve both as the simulation of scene dynamics and as their persistent representation, grounding observations when moving content leaves and later re-enters the target view.
paragraphs.zh: Momentum 是一个两阶段流水线，它生成一个不断演化的世界状态，并利用该状态为相机控制的视频提供依据。 我们方法的架构如图 2 所示。 状态 S t S_{t} 由参考相机阵列视角组成，并随时间推进而非保持固定。 WorldUpdate 实现状态转移 S H : H + T = g ( S H ) S_{H:H+T}=g(S_{H})，跨相机阵列生成同步视频，以独立于目标相机轨迹的方式表示场景动态。 WorldInteract 实现观测模型 h h，以观测历史、相机轨迹和对应的世界状态为条件，生成目标相机视频。 因此，参考视频既作为场景动态的模拟，也作为其持久化表示，在运动内容离开目标视野并随后重新进入时为观测提供依据。

paragraphs.en: WorldUpdate is the component of Momentum responsible for advancing the world state through synchronized reference-camera video generation. It requires consistency both across cameras within a rig and across spatially distributed rigs observing shared content. To meet these requirements, we introduce the Multi-Rig Dynamically Grounded World Model (Multi-Rig DGWM) as an architecture for this component, combining joint multi-view generation with geometric conditioning between rigs.
paragraphs.zh: WorldUpdate 是 Momentum 中负责通过同步的参考相机视频生成来推进世界状态的组件。 它既要求同一相机阵列内部各相机之间的一致性，也要求观测共享内容的多个空间分布式相机阵列之间的一致性。 为满足这些要求，我们提出多阵列动态接地世界模型（Multi-Rig DGWM）作为该组件的架构，将联合多视角生成与阵列间的几何条件约束相结合。

sents.en: WorldUpdate is the component of Momentum responsible for advancing the world state through synchronized reference-camera video generation.
sents.zh: WorldUpdate 是 Momentum 中负责通过同步的参考相机视频生成来推进世界状态的组件。

sents.en: It requires consistency both across cameras within a rig and across spatially distributed rigs observing shared content.
sents.zh: 它既要求同一相机阵列内部各相机之间的一致性，也要求观测共享内容的多个空间分布式相机阵列之间的一致性。

sents.en: To meet these requirements, we introduce the Multi-Rig Dynamically Grounded World Model (Multi-Rig DGWM) as an architecture for this component, combining joint multi-view generation with geometric conditioning between rigs.
sents.zh: 为满足这些要求，我们提出多阵列动态接地世界模型（Multi-Rig DGWM）作为该组件的架构，将联合多视角生成与阵列间的几何条件约束相结合。

paragraphs.en: Multi-Rig DGWM builds on the pretrained multi-view video diffusion transformer of Cosmos-Predict 2.5 ( Ali et al., 2025 ) , trained on autonomous driving data. It extends its seven-view configuration to the eight cameras of our rigs by adding an extra learnable view embedding. View-stacked attention exchanges information across cameras during joint generation, supporting cross-view consistency. We incorporate the warped-video channels of geometric referencing and the Plücker camera residual from the grounded model. Semantic reference tokens, the virtual lookahead sink, and their associated attention masks are omitted: each fixed camera’s generated history anchors its viewpoint and appearance, while reprojected neighbor videos provide spatially aligned conditioning on scene evolution.
paragraphs.zh: Multi-Rig DGWM 构建于 Cosmos-Predict 2.5（Ali et al., 2025）的预训练多视角视频扩散 Transformer 之上，该模型在自动驾驶数据上训练得到。 它通过添加一个额外的可学习视角嵌入，将其七视角配置扩展到我们设备组的八个相机。 视角堆叠注意力在联合生成过程中跨相机交换信息，从而支持跨视角一致性。 我们融合了几何参照的扭曲视频通道以及来自 grounded 模型的 Plücker 相机残差。 语义参照词元、虚拟前瞻汇点及其相关的注意力掩码均被省略：每个固定相机生成的历史为其视角和外观提供锚定，而重投影的邻近视频则为场景演化提供空间对齐的条件信息。

sents.en: Multi-Rig DGWM builds on the pretrained multi-view video diffusion transformer of Cosmos-Predict 2.5 ( Ali et al., 2025 ) , trained on autonomous driving data.

sents.zh: 我们融合了几何参照的扭曲视频通道以及来自 grounded 模型的 Plücker 相机残差。

sents.en: Semantic reference tokens, the virtual lookahead sink, and their associated attention masks are omitted: each fixed camera’s generated history anchors its viewpoint and appearance, while reprojected neighbor videos provide spatially aligned conditioning on scene evolution.
sents.zh: 语义参照词元、虚拟前瞻汇点及其相关的注意力掩码均被省略：每个固定相机生成的历史为其视角和外观提供锚定，而重投影的邻近视频则为场景演化提供空间对齐的条件信息。

paragraphs.en: Independent rig generation can produce conflicting depictions of shared content, including objects duplicating or disappearing between viewpoints. We therefore condition each rig on a neighbor’s synchronized video, unprojecting its views with depth and reprojecting them into the receiving rig using the known relative poses. During training, conditioning comes from the ground-truth video of the nearest other rig, allowing training samples to be processed independently. At inference, neighboring videos must themselves be generated, requiring a schedule that makes each conditioning source available before its dependent rig.
paragraphs.zh: 独立的相机机位组生成可能会产生对共享内容相互冲突的描绘，包括物体在不同视角之间重复出现或消失。 因此，我们让每个机位组以相邻机位组的同步视频为条件，利用深度将其视角反投影，并使用已知的相对位姿将其重投影到接收方机位组中。 在训练期间，条件来自最近的另一个机位组的真实视频，使训练样本可以独立处理。 在推理时，相邻视频本身也需要生成，因此需要一个调度方案，确保每个条件来源在其依赖的机位组之前可用。

paragraphs.en: We construct a graph connecting rigs close within a range to provide useful reprojection conditioning. Generation proceeds in chunks of one model window, overlapping by the conditioning frames to maintain temporal continuity. Within each chunk, we traverse the graph breadth-first from a source rig, which generates from its own history without neighbor conditioning. Each subsequent rig conditions on the freshly generated video of its nearest already-generated neighbor(s), while rigs at equal depth are generated together. This propagates scene evolution across the graph over a shared temporal interval.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建一个图，将在一定范围内相近的机位连接起来，以提供有用的重投影条件。 生成以一个模型窗口为块进行，各块通过条件帧重叠，以保持时间上的连续性。 在每个块内，我们从源机位出发对图进行广度优先遍历，该源机位仅根据自身历史进行生成，无需邻居条件。 随后的每个机位以距离其最近的已生成邻居（一个或多个）新生成的视频为条件，而处于相同深度的机位则一起生成。 这使得场景演化在共享的时间区间内沿图传播。

It must follow the specified camera trajectory while preserving the scene appearance and motion represented by the reference videos. For this component, we introduce the Dynamically Grounded World Model (Dynamically Grounded WM), retaining the architecture of the Statically Grounded World Model (Sec. 3.3 ) and fine-tuning it on synchronized dynamic grounding data (Sec. 3.2 ).

paragraphs.en: We evaluate our Statically Grounded World Model on the publicly available Ann Arbor driving data from MARS ( Li et al., 2024 ) , following SWM’s evaluation protocol, using masked versions of PSNR and LPIPS (see App. B ). This comparison assesses whether our reimplementation provides a competitive baseline despite training exclusively on synthetic data, whereas SWM additionally uses video interpolated from proprietary real-world panoramas. As shown in Tab. 2 , our model achieves higher mPSNR, lower mLPIPS, and lower rotation error than the reported SWM results, although translation error remains higher. These results establish a competitive image-grounded baseline for evaluating the benefits of dynamic grounding.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 MARS（Li et al., 2024）公开可用的 Ann Arbor 驾驶数据上评估我们的静态接地世界模型，遵循 SWM 的评估协议，使用掩码版本的 PSNR 和 LPIPS（见附录 B）。 这一对比评估了我们的重新实现尽管仅在合成数据上训练，是否能提供一个有竞争力的基线，而 SWM 额外使用了从专有真实世界全景图插值得到的视频。 如表 2 所示，与报告的 SWM 结果相比，我们的模型取得了更高的 mPSNR、更低的 mLPIPS 和更低的旋转误差，尽管平移误差仍然较高。 这些结果为评估动态接地的收益建立了一个有竞争力的图像接地基线。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate model choices for WorldInteract using ground-truth reference observations, isolating target-video generation from errors in WorldUpdate. We compare the Statically Grounded World Model conditioned on either fixed reference images from t = 0 t=0 or synchronized reference video against the Dynamically Grounded WM conditioned on video. Image conditioning reprojects the initial observations into each target viewpoint, while video conditioning uses time-aligned observations. Across scenes containing one or four reference-camera rigs, the Dynamically Grounded WM achieves the best visual fidelity, camera-trajectory accuracy, and static and dynamic scene consistency in both seen and unseen towns (Tab. 2 ). Supplying video conditioning to the statically trained model alone does not yield comparable gains, demonstrating the importance of training with synchronized dynamic grounding.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用真值参考观测来评估 WorldInteract 的模型选择，将目标视频生成与 WorldUpdate 中的误差隔离开来。 我们将基于 t = 0 t=0 时刻的固定参考图像或同步参考视频进行条件化的静态接地世界模型，与基于视频进行条件化的动态接地世界模型进行比较。 图像条件化将初始观测重新投影到每个目标视点，而视频条件化使用时间对齐的观测。 在包含一个或四个参考相机 rig 的场景中，动态接地世界模型在已见和未见的城镇中均实现了最佳的视觉保真度、相机轨迹精度以及静态和动态场景一致性（表 2）。 仅为静态训练的模型提供视频条件化并不能带来相当的提升，这表明使用同步动态接地进行训练的重要性。

sents.en: We evaluate model choices for WorldInteract using ground-truth reference observations, isolating target-video generation from errors in WorldUpdate.
sents.zh: 我们使用真值参考观测来评估 WorldInteract 的模型选择，将目标视频生成与 WorldUpdate 中的误差隔离开来。

sents.en: We compare the Statically Grounded World Model conditioned on either fixed reference images from t = 0 t=0 or synchronized reference video against the Dynamically Grounded WM conditioned on video.
sents.zh: 我们将基于 t = 0 t=0 时刻的固定参考图像或同步参考视频进行条件化的静态接地世界模型，与基于视频进行条件化的动态接地世界模型进行比较。

sents.en: Image conditioning reprojects the initial observations into each target viewpoint, while video conditioning uses time-aligned observations.
sents.zh: 图像条件化将初始观测重新投影到每个目标视点，而视频条件化使用时间对齐的观测。

sents.en: Across scenes containing one or four reference-camera rigs, the Dynamically Grounded WM achieves the best visual fidelity, camera-trajectory accuracy, and static and dynamic scene consistency in both seen and unseen towns (Tab. 2 ).
sents.zh: 在包含一个或四个参考相机 rig 的场景中，动态接地世界模型在已见和未见的城镇中均实现了最佳的视觉保真度、相机轨迹精度以及静态和动态场景一致性（表 2）。

sents.en: Supplying video conditioning to the statically trained model alone does not yield comparable gains, demonstrating the importance of training with synchronized dynamic grounding.
sents.zh: 仅为静态训练的模型提供视频条件化并不能带来相当的提升，这表明使用同步动态接地进行训练的重要性。

paragraphs.en: We next vary the number of rigs supplying conditioning within four-rig scenes, using either one or three source rigs with the same model and conditioning choices. From each source, we select the two camera views closest in orientation to the target camera and combine their reprojections into a single conditioning image per target frame. The Dynamically Grounded WM outperforms both baselines with either source count (Tab. 3 ). In seen towns, one source provides better visual and semantic consistency, while three slightly improve camera-trajectory accuracy. In the unseen town, three sources improve all metrics, despite training with a single source rig, showing that the model can exploit additional reference coverage at inference.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们在四台设备的场景中改变提供条件信息的设备数量，使用一台或三台具有相同模型和条件设置的源设备。 对于每个源，我们选择与目标相机朝向最接近的两个相机视角，并将它们的重投影合并为每个目标帧的一张条件图像。 无论源数量如何，动态接地世界模型均优于两个基线（Tab. 3）。 在见过的城镇中，单个源能提供更好的视觉和语义一致性，而三个源能略微提高相机轨迹的准确性。 在未见过的城镇中，尽管训练时仅使用单个源设备，三个源仍能提升所有指标，这表明模型能够在推理时利用额外的参考覆盖范围。

paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个测试集上使用逐帧PSNR评估视觉保真度在整个生成过程中如何变化。 如图3所示，动态接地世界模型（Dynamically Grounded WM）比使用静态接地的模型在更长时间内更一致地保持视觉保真度。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Momentum from static reference images, without ground-truth reference videos. The baselines directly condition target-video generation on these images, while Momentum uses WorldUpdate to generate an evolving world state through graph propagation and WorldInteract to ground target observations in that state. As shown in Tab. 4 , Momentum improves visual fidelity and both static and dynamic scene consistency over both baselines in seen and unseen towns. It also achieves the best camera-trajectory accuracy in the unseen town, while matching rotation accuracy but increasing translation error relative to the image-conditioned Dynamically Grounded WM in seen towns. Most notably, SCS-dyn improves over this baseline by 130.2 % 130.2\% and 126.2 % 126.2\% in seen and unseen towns, respectively, demonstrating the benefit of generating scene dynamics beyond those represented by static references.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在仅有静态参考图像、没有真值参考视频的条件下评估 Momentum。 各基线方法直接以这些图像为条件生成目标视频，而 Momentum 使用 WorldUpdate 通过图传播生成不断演进的世界状态，并使用 WorldInteract 将目标观测锚定在该状态中。 如表 4 所示，在已见和未见的城镇中，Momentum 相较两种基线方法都提升了视觉保真度以及静态和动态场景一致性。 在未见城镇中，它还取得了最佳的相机轨迹精度；在已见城镇中，相对于以图像为条件的 Dynamically Grounded WM，它保持了相当的旋转精度，但平移误差有所增加。 最值得注意的是，SCS-dyn 在已见和未见城镇中分别比该基线提升了 130.2 % 130.2\% 和 126.2 % 126.2\%，这表明生成超越静态参考所呈现内容的场景动态是有益的。

In Fig. 4 b, the multi-rig model renders objects consistently across views and predicts their movement, while the single-view model is inconsistent and tends to predict no movement (both models are seeded with single frame at t=0).

paragraphs.en: We introduced Momentum, a two-stage pipeline that grounds camera-controlled video generation in an evolving world state. Synchronized reference-camera videos represent scene appearance and dynamics beyond the target view, without explicit entity tracking or a static–dynamic decomposition. WorldUpdate advances this state through graph-propagated generation, while WorldInteract uses it to ground target-camera observations. We developed the Dynamically Grounded WM and Multi-Rig DGWM for these roles, together with a CARLA data-generation framework, an SWM-based Statically Grounded World Model, and an evaluation framework. Experiments in seen and unseen towns demonstrate improved visual fidelity, controllability and scene consistency through dynamic grounding. Compared with the Dynamically Grounded WM conditioned on static image references, Momentum improves dynamic scene consistency (SCS-dyn) by 130.2 % 130.2\% in seen towns and 126.2 % 126.2\% in the unseen town. These results open a path toward spatially extensible video world models in which multiple viewpoints and interactions share a consistently evolving scene.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了Momentum，这是一个两阶段流水线，将相机可控的视频生成建立在不断演进的世界状态之上。 同步的参考相机视频能够表达目标视角之外的场景外观与动态，而无需显式的实体跟踪或静态—动态分解。 WorldUpdate通过图传播生成来推进这一状态，而WorldInteract则利用该状态为目标相机的观测提供依据。 我们为这两种角色开发了Dynamically Grounded WM和Multi-Rig DGWM，并配套构建了一个CARLA数据生成框架、一个基于SWM的Statically Grounded World Model，以及一个评估框架。 在已见与未见城镇中的实验表明，动态接地提升了视觉保真度、可控性和场景一致性。 与以静态图像参考为条件的Dynamically Grounded WM相比，Momentum在已见城镇中将动态场景一致性（SCS-dyn）提升了130.2 % 130.2\%，在未见城镇中提升了126.2 % 126.2\%。 这些结果为空间可扩展的视频世界模型开辟了一条道路，使多个视角和交互能够共享一个持续一致演化的场景。

paragraphs.en: All observations are rendered using 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 pinhole cameras with a 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} field of view. Each capture stores RGB video together with per-frame camera extrinsics, intrinsics, and GNSS measurements; depth is stored losslessly. Data collection is configured declaratively, supports resuming interrupted sessions, and can be distributed across multiple CARLA servers.

paragraphs.en: Panoramic rigs are placed at road waypoints with a random positional offset of up to 1.5 1.5 m. Each rig contains eight co-located cameras with yaw offsets spaced by 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} and records both RGB and depth. Target vehicle trajectories use an autopilot vehicle travelling at a randomized fraction below the local speed limit. Pedestrian trajectories use an eye-height camera at 1.65 1.65 m mounted to an AI walker with randomly sampled navigation goals. Flyover trajectories follow collision-checked random walks at 2 2 – 8 8 m altitude, with camera pitch sampled around − 20 ∘ -20^{\circ} with ± 15 ∘ \pm 15^{\circ} variation and additional yaw perturbations. We render 20 20 sessions per town and trajectory type.
paragraphs.zh: 全景采集架放置在道路路径点上，并附加最大 1.5 1.5 米的随机位置偏移。 每个采集架包含八台同位置摆放的相机，其偏航角偏移以 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} 间隔分布，并同时记录 RGB 与深度数据。 目标车辆轨迹使用在低于当地限速的随机比例速度下行驶的自动驾驶车辆。 行人轨迹使用安装于 AI 行人身上、高度为 1.65 1.65 米的视平高度相机，并随机采样导航目标点。 航拍轨迹遵循经过碰撞检测的随机游走，高度为 2 2 – 8 8 米，相机俯仰角在 − 20 ∘ -20^{\circ} 附近采样并带有 ± 15 ∘ \pm 15^{\circ} 的变化，同时附加偏航角扰动。 我们在每个城镇和每种轨迹类型下渲染 20 20 个会话。

paragraphs.en: Each session consists of a single synchronous CARLA rollout of 300 300 frames at 10 10 fps. paragraphs.en: The backbone is the 2 2 B Cosmos-Predict2.5 DiT: 28 28 blocks of width 2048 2048 with 16 16 heads, spatial patch size 2 2 , AdaLN-LoRA of rank 256 256 , and 3D RoPE. The VAE compresses by 4 × 4\times temporally and 8 × 8\times spatially into 16 16 latent channels. Three modifications are made. First, the input embedder is widened from 16 16 to 32 32 latent channels so that the warped video of the geometric pathway can be concatenated to the noisy target; with the condition and padding masks, the network sees 34 34 channels. Second, separate patch embedders, weight-initialised from the base embedder, are added for reference and sink latents. Third, RoPE temporal indices are decoupled from position in the token sequence, allowing references and the lookahead sink to be placed outside the generation window, and attention masks are added for reference and sink padding. All remaining blocks are inherited unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 骨干网络是 Cosmos-Predict2.5 DiT：28 个宽度为 2048、含 16 个头的块，空间 patch 大小为 2，AdaLN-LoRA 秩为 256，并使用 3D RoPE。 VAE 在时间上压缩 4 倍，在空间上压缩 8 倍，得到 16 个潜通道。 我们做了三处修改。 第一，将输入嵌入器从 16 个潜通道加宽到 32 个潜通道，以便几何通路的 warped 视频可以与带噪目标拼接；再加上条件掩码和填充掩码，网络共看到 34 个通道。 第二，为参考潜变量和 sink 潜变量添加了独立的 patch 嵌入器，其权重从基础嵌入器初始化。 第三，RoPE 的时间索引与 token 序列中的位置解耦，使参考帧和 lookahead sink 可以放在生成窗口之外，并为参考和 sink 填充添加了注意力掩码。 其余所有块均原样继承。

paragraphs.en: Each chunk covers 77 77 pixel frames, which the causal VAE encodes to L = 20 L=20 latents, preceded by H = 5 H=5 history latents, for a 25 25 -latent generation window. We use K = 5 K=5 references, a reference gap of G ref = 50 G_{\mathrm{ref}}=50 latent positions, an inter-reference spacing of 1 1 , and a lookahead offset of Δ VL = 5 \Delta_{\mathrm{VL}}=5 latent frames. Clean conditioning latents (history, references, and sink) are assigned timestep 0 0 under the base model’s per-frame AdaLN.
paragraphs.zh: 每个分块覆盖 77 个像素帧，因果 VAE 将其编码为 L = 20 个潜变量，前面还有 H = 5 个历史潜变量，构成 25 个潜变量的生成窗口。 我们使用 K = 5 个参考、参考间隔 G_ref = 50 个潜变量位置、参考间间距为 1，以及前瞻偏移 Δ_VL = 5 个潜变量帧。 干净的条件潜变量（历史、参考和汇点）在基础模型的逐帧 AdaLN 下被赋予时间步 0。

paragraphs.en: We fine-tune from the public Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B checkpoint for 10 10 K iterations at 704 × 1280 704\times 1280 resolution with AdamW ( lr = 4.8 × 10 − 5 \mathrm{lr}=4.8\times 10^{-5} , weight decay 0.001 0.001 , β = ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) \beta=(0.9,0.999) ), 100 100 warm-up steps, and gradient clipping at 0.1 0.1 , under the base rectified-flow recipe (logit-normal timestep sampling, shift 5 5 ). Training is sharded with FSDP across 8 8 NVIDIA H100 GPUs at a per-GPU batch size of 1 1 . To avoid over-reliance on any single conditioning signal, we perturb history latents with Gaussian noise of standard deviation 0.1 0.1 with probability 0.5 0.5 , and drop the reference and warped-video pathways independently with probability 0.2 0.2 each.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从公开的 Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B 检查点出发进行微调，共 10 10 K 次迭代，分辨率为 704 × 1280 704\times 1280，使用 AdamW（ lr = 4.8 × 10 − 5 \mathrm{lr}=4.8\times 10^{-5} ，权重衰减 0.001 0.001 ， β = ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) \beta=(0.9,0.999) ），100 100 步预热，梯度裁剪阈值为 0.1 0.1，并采用基础整流流训练方案（logit-normal 时间步采样，shift 为 5 5）。 训练通过 FSDP 在 8 8 块 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上进行分片，每块 GPU 的批大小为 1 1 。 为避免对任何单一条件信号的过度依赖，我们以 0.5 0.5 的概率向历史潜变量添加标准差为 0.1 0.1 的高斯噪声，并以各 0.2 0.2 的概率独立丢弃参考图像通路和形变视频通路。

paragraphs.en: Chunks are rolled out sequentially with a rectified-flow ODE sampler using 35 35 steps and classifier-free guidance of 3.0 3.0 , with only the history latents carried forward; the camera trajectory, retrieved references, and sink are re-derived at every chunk.
paragraphs.zh: 分块通过使用 35 35 步的整流流 ODE 采样器依次生成，无分类器引导系数为 3.0 3.0，仅携带历史潜变量向前传递；相机轨迹、检索到的参考内容以及汇聚点在每一分块中都会重新推导。

paragraphs.en: The rig model is initialised from the released 2 2 B multi-view Cosmos-Predict2.5 checkpoint, with an eighth view-embedding row appended to its seven-slot table and the warped-video latent appended to the input embedder, giving 41 41 input channels ( 16 16 noisy, 1 1 condition mask, 1 1 padding mask, 7 7 view, 16 16 warped). Every pretrained column keeps its index, so the conversion only adds zero-initialised weights. All eight views of a rig are generated jointly at 192 × 352 192\times 352 per view with 8 8 latent frames per view, corresponding to 29 29 pixel frames per chunk. Generation is conditioned on a single history latent ( h = 1 h=1 ), with the initial chunk conditioned on one ground-truth frame per view of each rig.
paragraphs.zh: 该装置模型从发布的 22B 多视角 Cosmos-Predict2.5 检查点初始化，在其七槽位表中追加了第八个视角嵌入行，并将扭曲视频潜变量追加到输入嵌入器中，从而得到 41 个输入通道（16 个噪声、1 个条件掩码、1 个填充掩码、7 个视角、16 个扭曲）。 每个预训练列都保持其索引不变，因此转换只添加零初始化的权重。 一个装置的全部八个视角被联合生成，每个视角分辨率为 192×352，每个视角包含 8 个潜变量帧，对应每个块 29 个像素帧。 生成以单个历史潜变量（h=1）为条件，初始块以每个装置每个视角的一帧真实帧为条件。

paragraphs.en: We fine-tune for 10 10 K iterations with AdamW ( lr = 3 × 10 − 5 \mathrm{lr}=3\times 10^{-5} , weight decay 10 − 3 10^{-3} , β = ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) \beta=(0.9,0.999) ), 100 100 warm-up steps, and gradient clipping at 0.1 0.1 , sharded with FSDP. The warped latent is dropped with probability 0.2 0.2 per sample, which both teaches the model to generate without a reprojection source and provides the branch without reprojection conditioning for classifier-free guidance. This rate is chosen to approximate how often a rig is the graph source at inference.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 AdamW（学习率 \mathrm{lr}=3\times 10^{-5}，权重衰减 10^{-3}，\beta=(0.9,0.999)）进行 10 K 次迭代的微调，采用 100 步预热、0.1 的梯度裁剪，并使用 FSDP 进行分片。 扭曲后的潜变量在每个样本中以 0.2 的概率被丢弃，这既教会模型在没有重投影来源的情况下进行生成，也为无分类器引导提供了不带重投影条件的分支。 选择该比例是为了近似推断时骨骼绑定作为图来源的频率。

paragraphs.en: The target-camera model is fine-tuned from the statically grounded checkpoint described in App. A.2 on the dynamic grounding sessions, retaining that model’s chunk geometry, optimiser settings, and conditioning dropout. paragraphs.en: In this experiment we evaluate the multi-view abilities of our WorldUpdate model for generating video across rigs and views. To this end, we take the two closest to the current camera orientations of the neighboring rigs and reproject them to the current view. paragraphs.en: Results are shown in Tab. 5 . A baseline that freezes the conditioning frame achieves the best PSNR and LPIPS. This is a property of the setting: the rig cameras are stationary, so most of the image is static in time and visual metrics reward generating no motion. SCS-dyn is affected in the same way. It is an overlap score, and over one evaluation step a moving object still overlaps most of itself, so a frozen frame is credited with the overlap the object retains, while a model that moves it is penalised wherever its motion departs from the single recorded future. Both must therefore be read together with the staticness gap. WorldInteract stays close to the frozen baseline in staticness, and inherits its PSNR, LPIPS and SCS-dyn from that. WorldUpdate has the lowest staticness gap in every configuration, moving the scene by roughly the amount the ground truth does, and pays for it on every metric that rewards freezing, while preserving static structure best of all generative models (SCS-st) and exceeding the frozen baseline on it in the seen towns. This experiment thus exposes a trade-off between a preference for static content and dynamic accuracy across models, and a bias of the metrics themselves towards the former.
paragraphs.zh: 结果见表 5。 冻结条件帧的基线在 PSNR 和 LPIPS 上取得最佳结果。 这是该设置本身的特性：架设的相机是固定的，因此图像的大部分内容在时间上是静止的，视觉指标会奖励不产生运动。 SCS-dyn 也以同样的方式受到影响。 它是一个重叠分数，而在一次评估步骤中，运动物体仍与其自身大部分重叠，因此冻结的帧会被计入物体保留的重叠部分，而使其发生运动的模型则会在运动偏离唯一记录的未来轨迹之处受到惩罚。 因此，两者必须结合静止性差距一起解读。 WorldInteract 在静止性上接近冻结基线，并由此继承了其 PSNR、LPIPS 和 SCS-dyn。 WorldUpdate 在所有配置下都有最低的静止性差距，使场景发生大致与真实值相同的运动量，并因此在所有奖励冻结的指标上付出代价，同时在所有生成模型中对静态结构的保留最好（SCS-st），且在已见过的城镇中在该指标上超过冻结基线。 因此，该实验揭示了各模型在对静态内容的偏好与动态准确性之间的权衡，以及指标本身对前者的偏倚。
